title: CLO 2024.1 - Extension Panel
description: CLO2024.1, let your designs evolve again! The extension tool has been optimized in the new version, now allowing the extension of panels to be operated with symmetrical movement of the panels on both the left and right sides!
transcript:
From version 2024.1, we have optimized the extension tool.  
Now, for boards that are fully symmetrical left and right and linked, the extension board operation is enabled.  
Through this video, let's learn in detail how to use the extension tool.  

In the extension tool section of the 2D toolbar, you can see that there are two extension tools available:  
- Extension board slice point  
- Extension board slice line  

First, let's look at the optimized extension tool.  
Click on the extension board slice line.  
The tool will switch to the extension board slice line mode.  
You can see the tool icon and text prompt on the light bar.  

Click on the start and end points of section 1 that need to be extended.  
Now we want to use the tool to extend the front and bottom.  
So, we use the extension as section 1.  
Click on the start and end points to complete the selection of section 1.  
The text prompt on the icon changes accordingly.  

Click on the start and end points of section 2 that needs to be extended — the bottom line as section 2.  
Select the start and end points to complete the selection of section 2.  

Click on the extension board slice window.  
You can enter the total length value for the bottom and section 2 according to design requirements.  
You can also enter the distance value by which to move.  
Entering a negative value will shorten the bottom.  
All changes can be previewed in the 2D window.  

After entering the values, click OK.  
The extension is completed on the front side.  

Next, let's see how to use the other extension tool, the extension board slice point.  
Extend the bottom of the back piece.  
Long press the extension board slice line icon.  
Click on the extension board slice point.  
The tool will switch to extension board slice point mode.  
You can see the icon and text prompt on the light bar.  

Click on the line and draw the baseline.  
Now we want to use the extension board slice bottom of the back piece tool.  
You can use the side view point of the back piece as the starting point.  
An arrow pointing downwards will appear.  
You can press the Shift key.  
Draw a vertical baseline according to the instruction line.  
Set the extension position at the bottom as the end point.  
Click again to complete the baseline.  

The light bar will rotate clockwise to one side.  
The plate on this side of the baseline will be extended with the side view point as the center.  
You can also shorten the bottom.  
A text prompt will appear on the light bar.  

Press the D key to maintain the angle increment when rotating.  
So, press the D key during operation to maintain the bottom angle increment during extension.  

Right-click will open the extension dialog.  
You can enter the length of the plate to be extended or input the extension angle.  
After entering the values, click OK.  
The extension of the back piece is completed.  

The above is an introduction to the extension tool.  
I hope this function helps you be more efficient in completing plate extensions.

chunks.content: ## Overview of Extension Tool in CLO 2024.1 This section introduces the optimized extension tool available from CLO version 2024.1, designed for extending boards that are fully symmetrical and linked on left and right sides. The tool provides two modes—**extension board slice line** and **extension board slice point**—to facilitate precise extension operations in 2D pattern design. --- ## Extension Board Slice Line Tool This section explains the usage of the **extension board slice line** tool, which allows users to extend edges of pattern pieces by selecting slice lines and specifying extension lengths or movement distances. ### Tool Activation and Interface - Select the **extension board slice line** from the extension tool section in the 2D toolbar. - The tool switches mode, indicated by an icon and text prompt on the light bar. ### Procedure to Extend Sections 1. **Select Section 1** Click the start and end points of the first section (e.g., front and bottom edge) to be extended. 2. **Select Section 2** Similarly, click the start and end points of the second section (e.g., bottom line). 3. **Input Extension Values** - Open the extension board slice window. - Enter the total length value for the target section according to design requirements. - Optionally enter a distance value to move the extension line; negative values shorten the edge. - Preview changes live in the 2D view. 4. **Confirm Extension** Click **OK** to apply the extension. The pattern piece is updated accordingly. --- ## Extension Board Slice Point Tool This section covers the **extension board slice point** tool, used primarily for extending pattern pieces by defining a baseline with a starting point and extension position, offering more control through angle and distance inputs. ### Tool Activation and Interface - Long press the extension board slice line icon to reveal and select the **extension board slice point** tool. - The mode change is shown via icon and prompt on the light bar. ### Procedure to Extend Using Slice Point 1. **Draw Baseline** - Click on the line and drag to create a baseline. - Use a side view point on the pattern piece as the start point (e.g., bottom of the back piece). - An arrow indicating the extension direction appears. 2. **Use Shift Key for Vertical Baseline** - Hold **Shift** to constrain the baseline vertically, aligning with instruction lines. 3. **Set Extension Position** - Click to set the end point of the baseline at the desired extension position (e.g., bottom edge). 4. **Rotation and Angle Control** - The light bar rotates clockwise, indicating which side of the baseline will be extended. - Press **D** during rotation to maintain fixed angle increments, preserving consistent bottom angle during extension. 5. **Extension Dialog** - Right-click to open the extension dialog. - Enter extension length or extension angle values. - Click **OK** to apply the extension. --- ## Summary CLO 2024.1 introduces enhanced extension tools for symmetrical and linked boards, allowing precise extension of pattern pieces via two methods: slice line and slice point.
